compiled_state.title: [test-merge-to-main-version-bump]: test_version_bump_marks_state_complete fails on CI -> PR script-tests blocked while passing locally 20/20
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Flaky test discovered in PR #93 (alias backfill).

**Symptom**: `test_version_bump_marks_state_complete` asserts that `_phase_version_bump` writes 'version_bump' to state.completed_phases; CI sees the value missing and fails with expected=version_bump actual=missing|no_state_file.

**Reproduction**:
- Local: `bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh` passes 20/20 consistently.
- CI on PR #93 (run 25707344247, job 75480354335): 19/20 with this one failing.
- CI on main: consistently 20/20 across the last 5 runs.

**Evidence it is flaky, not branch-specific**: rerun of the same PR (run 25707344247 retried, job 75481134774) succeeded on this test but a different test in the same batch failed (test-test-batched.sh::test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume) — different failure each pass on the same code is the flakiness signature.

**Likely root cause**: state-file write race in `_phase_version_bump` (or its mocked bump-version helper), only observable when CI runs many tests in parallel; `_state_init` / `_phase_version_bump` may be reading the state file before the prior write fsyncs. Worth checking whether the mock_bump_version setup races with state-file writes.
